the issue goes beyond the educational crisis and learning gaps among students more often than not the underlying problem stems from the lack of adequate teacher training and insufficient support from the education sector this is especially evident in special education programs where many teachers lack the resources training and institutional support needed to effectively handle children with special needs or learning disabilities ultimately this problem reflects systemic issues within the government particularly within the department of education although there is a substantial budget allocated to deped there is little transparency and accountability regarding how these funds are utilized as a result students especially those from marginalized sectors bear the greatest burden furthermore mass promotion should exclude and never be applied to persons with disabilities pwds as it jeopardizes the learning rights of children with special needs neurotypical and neurodivergent learners have different needs and learning trajectories and treating them the same undermines inclusive and equitable education
